title: 13.17. Uppannattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Uppanno dhammo naanuppannassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava …pe… upanissaye nava …pe… avigate tīṇi.
